### Description:
- The document outlines the tuition fees for Jordanian and international students pursuing a higher specialization in medicine and dentistry at the University of Jordan.
- It is structured in tables for clarity, separating fees that are one-time charges from annual fees. Each table shows different types of fees along with the total amount.
